title: Writing / Style / Money
slide_intent: Show monetary amounts with only useful precision so readers can compare a price without extra notation.
strategic_value: Whole amounts, decimal prices and sub-dollar examples can help Duolingo make price communication consistent.
demonstration: Three checked examples show a whole-dollar amount, a monthly decimal price and a cents-per-day amount.
practical_value: Choose the symbol and precision treatment according to the amount.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the topic heading, its parent label and the written convention in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Place the worked copy in the pale right panel, keeping preference labels and green checks with their examples.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples show $25, $9.99 a month and 33 cents a day.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Put the currency symbol before the amount; omit .00 for whole amounts; write amounts below one dollar as x cents.

ingredient.name: Money convention
ingredient.role: Readers can compare a price without extra notation.
ingredient.application: Put the currency symbol before the amount; omit .00 for whole amounts; write amounts below one dollar as x cents.
